name: axi-plugins
description: Every AXI CLI as an installable plugin — agent-ergonomic tools for GitHub, AWS, Cloudflare, Coolify, OpenPanel, Chrome DevTools, and provider quotas. Zero per-turn token cost, unlike an MCP server.

plugins.name: gh-axi
plugins.description: GitHub from the shell: issues, pull requests, stacked PRs, workflow runs, releases, Projects, Actions secrets, gists, and raw API access.

plugins.name: aws-axi
plugins.description: AWS operations: EC2, S3, IAM, Lambda, KMS, CloudWatch, SSM, Secrets Manager, and any other service. Prefer over raw `aws`.

plugins.name: cloudflare-axi
plugins.description: Cloudflare zones, DNS records, edge cache purging, Email Routing, and bot-protection diagnosis.

plugins.name: coolify-axi
plugins.description: Coolify applications, databases, services, servers, and deployments on a self-hosted or cloud instance.

plugins.name: openpanel-axi
plugins.description: OpenPanel analytics: visitors, pages, traffic sources, devices, campaigns, raw events, plus project/client management and event tracking.

plugins.name: chrome-devtools-axi
plugins.description: Drive a real Chrome session: navigate, click, fill forms, run JavaScript, read console and network, screenshot, audit performance.

plugins.name: quota-axi
plugins.description: Local quota windows for Claude, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Grok, Kimi, Z.AI, and more — remaining runway, pace, and reset times.
